                    Issue with Contacts Entering Mailchimp Flow Automations
                    »

                                                            View Event Details
                            
                            | Created Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:37:00 +0000

                                            
            Update
        Engineers have resolved the issue with the subset of Mailchimp accounts that experienced contacts not entering Flow Automations after signup. We thank you for your patience.
    Posted: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:57:00 +0000
                                            
            Investigating
        We are currently aware of and investigating an issue with contacts not entering Flow Automations after signup for a subset of Mailchimp accounts. Our Engineering team is working on a resolution and we will provide further updates as they become available.
    Posted: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:37:00 +0000
